summary: Benton County, Tennessee fire tower at 642 ft, numbered 8-2 on the state's 1976 list; listed as removed, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed in the Tennessee Landforms tower table; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Numbered 8-2 (district 8, tower 2) on a 1976 state list of towers, per the table's note
Tennessee Landforms table marks the tower removed; no removal year given

notes_for_editor: Identity rests on the Tennessee Landforms table only (waypoint BNT001, 642 ft, Benton, 'GD1471 8-2 removed'). The table's author says some names are his own, so the name is unverified. The agency is inferred from the table's note that the numbers are state forest tower numbers from a 1976 state list; no source names an agency for this tower. The table's NGS-style code GD1471 is not explained on the page and is left out of the story. No build date, builder, staffing dates or removal year appear in any source read. Not on the NHLR or FFLOS Tennessee lists (checked 2026-10-21). The MPS is about surviving TDF towers and does not mention Big Sandy by name. Photos: none found.
